question.prompt: Kim’s flight took off from Newark at \(10{:}34\) am and landed in Miami at \(1{:}18\) pm. Both cities are in the same time zone. If her flight took \(h\) hours and \(m\) minutes, with \(0 \le m \lt 60,\) what is \(h + m?\)

solutions.explanation:
Both cities use the same time zone, so we can compare the clock readings directly. From \(10{:}34\) am to \(12{:}34\) pm is \(2\) hours. From \(12{:}34\) pm to \(1{:}18\) pm is
\[
(60-34)+18=44
\]
minutes. Thus \(h=2\) and \(m=44\), which satisfies \(0\le m<60\). Therefore
\[
h+m=2+44=\boxed{46},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
solutions.title: Count the elapsed time
